name: GEF Small Grants Programme (CEPF-executed countries)
summary: GEF Small Grants run by CEPF for Conservation International in Equatorial Guinea, Libya and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, giving grants of up to US$75,000 to registered civil society organisations through competitive calls.

amount.note: Upper limit; a lower limit may be set for individual calls

administered_by.quote: with the Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF) serving as its executing agency.

applicant_types.quote: Civil society organizations (CSOs) are eligible to receive an SGP grant if they: (a) are legally registered in the country in question;

geography.quote: the CI/CEPF team will implement the SGP in five countries: Equatorial Guinea Libya Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Sri Lanka Turkmenistan

access.quote: Regular SGP grants are solicited through competitive, open calls.

amount.quote: Regular SGP grants have an upper limit of US$75,000, although a lower limit may be set for individual calls for proposals.

window.quote: It is anticipated that there will be at least one call for proposals in each country in both 2026 and 2027.
